tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rtsa gsum rnal 'byor bsdus pa bzhugs so//

na mo/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dkon mchog gsum// dam can srung ma'i tshogs la bdag skyabs mchi// bdag gis 'gro drug sems can bsgral ba'i phyir// rtsa gsum rnal 'byor lam la brtson par bgyi// rang nyid dpa' bo rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal| |phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pa thod khrag thogs// rin chen rus pa dar gyi rgyan dang ldan// spyi bor rta mgo stag sham brkyang bskum gar| |pang du rdo rje phag mo phag zhal ngur// rdo rje thod pa zhabs g.yas yab la 'khril// gzig sham dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan// rta zhal spyi bor pad+ma nyi ma'i steng*// skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma pad+ma 'byung*// dkar 'tsher rdo rje thod pa yum la 'khyud// snyan zhu rgod sgro dar sna me long brgyan// zab ber chos gos phod chen lhug par mnabs// rin chen rus pa'i rgyan can rdor skyil bzhugs// pang du mtsho rgyal dmar mo gri thod dang*// pad skyil yab 'khril gcer bu rin chen dang*// rus pas brgyan cing bde ba'i nyams dang ldan| |yab yum gnas gsum oṃ dkar āḥdamar po// hūm̐ mthing 'od kyis dpal ri pad 'od nas// bla ma spyan drangs thim zhing dgyes nyams bzhad| |phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nyid kyis mchod// phyag 'tshal sdig bshags dge la rjes yi rang*// chos 'khor bskor bskul yun du bzhugs gsol 'debs// dge ba sems can don du bsngo bar bgyi// hrīḥ dri med mtsho gling pad+ma'i ge sar las// legs 'khrungs rgyal ba kun dngos bla ma mchog /dgyes yum mtsho rgyal dag dang dga' bder rol// dus gsum bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs// dbang chen dpa' bo yi dam kun gyi dngos// rdo rje rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro kun dbang phyug /dam can rgya mtshos bar chad dgra bgegs 'dul// bdag la byin rlobs smin grol dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi de wa ḍā ki nī sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/

zhes ci 'grub bzlas mthar/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma yi// sku la gsol btab bdag gi lus sgrib sbyangs// bum pa'i dbang thob sprul skur bdag lus smin// bla ma'i gsung la gus pas gsol btab pas// bdag gi ngag sgrib sbyangs nas gsang dbang thob// longs skur smin byas bla ma'i thugs dag la// gus pas gsol btab bdag yid dri ma sbyangs// sher dbang thob cing rang sems chos skur smin// bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la gsol btab pas// yab yum bde sbyor dga' bde'i ngo bor zhu// bdag la thim pas sgo gsum dri ma sbyangs// bzhi pa'i dbang thob ngo bo nyid skur smin// rang sems gsal ba dpa' bo rta mgrin rgyal// stong pa'i rang mdangs rgyal yum rnal 'byor ma// snang stong zung 'jug spros bral gdod nas grub// 'dzin zhen mtha' bral rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang*// dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo// de skad ces pa 'bri gdan slob dpon pa'i// dbon po bla ma dkon mchog mtsho skyes kyis// bskul ngor skyu ra'i rigs las son pa ni// shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pa yis// gzho stod gnas chen ti sgro'i zhol 'dabs kyi// dben gnas 'brong ngur sum mdo'i g.ya' spyil du// bris pa'i dge bas 'gro kun don 'grub shog/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
